title: ABC Raceway

services.name: Red Clay Classic Champions
services.desc: Ashland, WI, September 27 - During a record-breaking weekend at the ABC Raceway’s 50th annual Red Clay Classic powered by Enbridge, Kevin Eder, Darrell Nelson, Dexton Koch and Tyler Vernon recorded wins on Saturday night. An event-record 260 entries from seven states and Canada overflowed the pit area in search of their share of an event-record - and perhaps WISSOTA-record - $250,000 purse, and nearly 6,000 fans enjoyed two sun-splashed days and crisp, comfortable early-Autumn evenings of racing action at the award-winning three-eighths-mile red-clay oval just south of Ashland.
